15 New Orleans hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. One snapshot on September 28, 2026 for Nov 2 to Nov 4, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for New Orleans hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 28, 2026 snapshot, at 14 of the 15 New Orleans hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 7, Traveluro at 2, Vio.com at 2, Billabook.com at 1, goseek.com at 1 and KAYAK.com at 1. These are the New Orleans rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at New Orleans hotels

At the 12 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 18% ($22 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 10% at W.G. Creole House 1850 to 19% at voco St. James Hotel by IHG. At 3 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
